title: On the recolorability of $(2K_2, K_4)$-free graphs
summary: Given a graph $G$ and an integer $\ell>χ(G)$, the reconfiguration graph of the $\ell$-colorings of $G$ has as its vertices as the proper $\ell$-colorings of $G$, with an edge between two colorings whenever they differ on exactly one vertex. We say that $G$ is \emph{recolorable} if this reconfiguration graph is connected for every $\ell>χ(G)$. Belavadi and Cameron determined which $(F_1,F_2)$-free graphs are recolorable whenever $F_1$ and $F_2$ are graphs on at most four vertices, with the single exception of $(2K_2,K_4)$-free graphs. Gaspers and Huang showed such graphs are $4$-colorable. The $3$-colorable case within this class has also been resolved, leaving the open question of whether every $(2K_2,K_4)$-free graph with chromatic number $4$ is recolorable. In this paper, we provide evidence toward an affirmative answer by establishing recolorability for three subclasses: $(2K_2,K_4,C_5)$-free graphs, $(2K_2,K_4,H_a,H_b)$-free graphs for any distinct $a,b\in \{2,3,4\}$, and $(2K_2,K_4,H_4)$-free graphs containing an induced $W_5$, where $H_i$ denotes the unique $2K_2$-free graph obtained from a $W_5$ by keeping exactly $i$ edges from the universal vertex to the cycle.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了三个子类中的$(2K_2,K_4)$-free图是可重着色的，为所有色数为4的此类图可重着色提供了证据。
AI.motivation: Belavadi和Cameron确定了几乎所有$(F_1,F_2)$-free图的可重着色性，但$(2K_2,K_4)$-free图是唯一未解决的例外。已知此类图是4-可着色的，且3-可着色情形已解决，但色数为4的情形是否可重着色仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 利用结构分析，将图分解为特定子结构（如$C_5$、$H_a$、$H_b$、$W_5$等），并通过构造重着色序列或使用归纳法证明连通性。
AI.result: 证明了以下三个子类中的$(2K_2,K_4)$-free图是可重着色的：$(2K_2,K_4,C_5)$-free图；$(2K_2,K_4,H_a,H_b)$-free图（$a,b\in\{2,3,4\}$且$a\neq b$）；以及包含诱导$W_5$的$(2K_2,K_4,H_4)$-free图。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果支持了所有$(2K_2,K_4)$-free图可重着色的猜想，并为最终解决该问题提供了重要子类。
AI.future_work: 完全解决$(2K_2,K_4)$-free图的可重着色性，特别是色数为4且不包含上述特殊结构的情形。

title: Minimal Isometric Embeddings of Graphs into Cayley Graphs of Finite Abelian Groups
summary: We study when, and how compactly, a finite connected graph (G) embeds isometrically into a Cayley graph of a finite abelian group. The classical theory of partial cubes answers this for isometric subgraphs of hypercubes through the Djokovic-Winkler relation (θ); we extend the question to the full family of abelian Cayley graphs, whose hosts may carry composite generators and cyclic factors of any order. We introduce an involutive edge relation (\varphi), defined by two simultaneous distance equalities, which coincides with (θ) exactly on partial cubes and remains informative beyond them, together with an oriented relation (Φ) for non-involutive hosts, where generator classes are constrained to be partial permutations rather than matchings.The central result is a quotient labeling theorem: for any partition of the edge set into candidate generator classes, the most generic consistent vertex labeling is the quotient of the free module on the classes by the lattice of signed cycle-class incidences, computed by the Smith normal form; the binary case is its reduction modulo two. We prove that the finest partition always yields an isometric labeling, that compactifying the resulting universal group is itself an instance of the same quotient construction, and that the whole construction is algorithmic and certifiable. Worked examples include the triangle, the Petersen graph (embedding into the Clebsch graph of order 16), the Pappus graph (a 1024-fold compaction), and the diamond (a non-diagonal fold). Sharp dimension bounds and an exhaustive census of small graphs are developed in a companion paper. 2020 MSC: 05C12, 05C25, 20K01, 05C50
comment: Submitted to European Journal of Combinatorics

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限连通图到有限阿贝尔群Cayley图的等距嵌入，引入新的边关系并给出商标号定理，将经典偏立方体理论推广到更一般的阿贝尔Cayley图。
AI.motivation: 经典偏立方体理论通过Djokovic-Winkler关系刻画了图到超立方体的等距嵌入，但超立方体只是阿贝尔Cayley图的一个特例。本文旨在将等距嵌入问题推广到所有有限阿贝尔群Cayley图，这些图可能具有复合生成元和任意阶循环因子，填补了该领域的一般性理论空白。
AI.method: 引入一个由两个同时距离等式定义的边关系$\varphi$，它在偏立方体上与Djokovic-Winkler关系$\theta$一致，但在更一般情形下仍有效；对于非对合宿主图，引入有向关系$\Phi$，其中生成元类被约束为部分置换而非匹配。核心方法是商标号定理：将边集划分为候选生成元类后，最一般的相容顶点标号是这些类上的自由模模去符号圈-类关联格的商，通过Smith标准型计算；二进制情形是模2约化。
AI.result: 主要定理：最细划分总能产生等距标号；将所得泛群紧化本身是同一商构造的实例；整个构造是算法化且可验证的。具体例子包括三角形、Petersen图（嵌入到16阶Clebsch图）、Pappus图（1024倍压缩）和钻石图（非对角折叠）。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将等距嵌入理论从超立方体推广到所有阿贝尔Cayley图，提供了统一的代数框架和算法，使得对任意有限连通图都能系统性地寻找其最紧凑的阿贝尔Cayley图嵌入。
AI.future_work: 论文提及伴随论文中给出了尖锐的维数界和小图的穷举普查，未来工作可进一步研究非阿贝尔群Cayley图的类似嵌入理论，或探索该构造在编码理论、网络设计中的应用。

title: Dimension and Order Bounds for Isometric Embeddings of Graphs into Abelian Cayley Graphs, and the Abelian Dividend
summary: We investigate the minimum size of finite abelian Cayley graphs that admit an isometric embedding of a finite connected graph. While every connected graph on n vertices embeds isometrically into a binary Cayley graph of dimension at most n-1, the smallest possible abelian host has remained largely unexplored. We establish fundamental lower bounds showing that every binary host has dimension at least max(diam(G), floor(log2 n)), whereas every finite abelian host has order at least max(n, 2^diam(G)). Moreover, we prove that the minimum host order equals n if and only if G is itself an abelian Cayley graph. Exact binary dimensions are obtained for several important graph families. Hypercubes, complete graphs of order 2^k, and even cycles attain the lower bound. For stars we prove k_min(K1,q)=floor(log2 q)+1 using maximum sum-free sets, yielding an exponential improvement over the naive and isometric dimensions. For odd cycles we prove k_min(Cm)=m-1 for all m<17 and reduce the general case to a cyclic-interval lemma, showing that the universal upper bound is tight. Our computational contribution is a certified exhaustive census of all 995 connected graphs with 2<=n<=7 vertices under general abelian compactifications. The data reveal an "abelian dividend": 569 graphs (57 percent) admit a strictly smaller abelian host than the best binary host, 707 (71 percent) admit an optimal host containing a cyclic factor Zm with m>2, and only 17 graphs attain the theoretical order floor max(n,2^diam(G)). These results demonstrate that compact non-binary abelian hosts are typical rather than exceptional, while binary hosts remain the universal worst-case construction. 2020 MSC:05C12, 05C25, 05C30, 11B75, 20K01
comment: Submitted to European Journal of Combinatorics

AI.tldr: 研究有限连通图到有限阿贝尔Cayley图的等距嵌入，给出最小维数和阶数的下界，并发现大多数图存在非二进制的更优阿贝尔宿主。
AI.motivation: 等距嵌入图到Cayley图是度量图论和代数图论的核心问题，但最小阿贝尔宿主的大小长期未解。该问题与图的直径、顶点数以及阿贝尔群结构密切相关，填补了二进制宿主之外的理论空白。
AI.method: 使用组合下界技术（如直径与顶点数的关系）、最大无和集（maximum sum-free sets）构造星图的嵌入、循环区间引理（cyclic-interval lemma）处理奇圈、穷举计算（certified exhaustive census）分析小图。
AI.result: 1. 二进制宿主维数至少为 $\max(\operatorname{diam}(G), \lfloor \log_2 n \rfloor)$，有限阿贝尔宿主阶数至少为 $\max(n, 2^{\operatorname{diam}(G)})$。2. 最小宿主阶数等于 $n$ 当且仅当 $G$ 本身是阿贝尔Cayley图。3. 星图 $K_{1,q}$ 的最小二进制维数为 $\lfloor \log_2 q \rfloor + 1$。4. 奇圈 $C_m$ 的最小二进制维数在 $m<17$ 时为 $m-1$。5. 对 $2\le n\le 7$ 的995个连通图，569个（57%）存在更小的非二进制阿贝尔宿主。
AI.conclusion: 非二进制阿贝尔宿主是普遍现象而非例外，二进制宿主仅为最坏情况构造。阿贝尔红利（abelian dividend）揭示了群结构在优化嵌入中的关键作用。
AI.future_work: 1. 奇圈 $C_m$ 对一般 $m$ 的最小二进制维数是否恒为 $m-1$？2. 阿贝尔宿主阶数的精确刻画，特别是达到下界 $\max(n, 2^{\operatorname{diam}(G)})$ 的图类。3. 将结果推广到非阿贝尔Cayley图或更一般的度量嵌入。

title: An Upper Bound on the Hat Guessing Number of Graphs
summary: The hat guessing number $HG(G)$ of a graph is defined by the following game: each player is placed on a vertex and assigned a hat with one of $k$ colors. Each vertex can see only the hat color of the other vertices it is connected to in $G$. All vertices guess, simultaneously, the color of their own hat. The hat guessing number $HG(G)$ is the largest $k$ such that the players can guarantee that at least one of them guesses correctly. In this paper, we show a general bound on the hat guessing number of a graph $G$ as a function of its order $n$ and its maximum degree $Δ$. This is the first nontrivial upper bound on $HG(G)$ as a function of $Δ$ and $n$ when $Δ\geq \frac{n}{e}$. From this result we also obtain that the hat guessing number of the random graph $G_{n,1/2}$ is at most asymptotically $cn$ for $c\sim 0.809$, and that graphs with maximum degrees of $ (1-\varepsilon )n$ for fixed $\varepsilon>0$ cannot have $HG(G)=(1-o(1))n$.

title: Extremal problems on disjoint path covers of graphs
summary: In 1962, Erdős characterized the maximum size of nonhamiltonian graphs of order $n$ with minimum degree at least $k$. Later, Ning and Peng [Combin. Probab. Comput. 29 (2020) 128-136] extended Erdős's results to the clique condition and provided the maximum clique number for nonhamiltonian graphs of order $n$ with minimum degree at least $k$. Recently, Zhang [European J. Combin. 112 (2023) 103728] determined the maximum number of $s$-cliques in nonhamiltonian graphs with prescribed order and minimum degree. A natural extension is to characterize the maximum number of $s$-cliques under other graph properties. Notably, disjoint path cover problems are closely related to Hamiltonicity. In this paper, we generalize results on Hamiltonicity and establish sufficient conditions for a graph to possess one-to-one, one-to-many and many-to-many $t$-disjoint path covers in terms of the number of cliques and the $α$-spectral radius, respectively. Furthermore, we characterize the extremal graphs that attain these bounds respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了图中不相交路径覆盖的极值问题，分别基于团数和$\alpha$-谱半径给出了图具有一对一、一对多和多对多$t$-不相交路径覆盖的充分条件，并刻画了达到这些界的极图。
AI.motivation: 不相交路径覆盖问题与哈密顿性密切相关，而Erdős和Ning-Peng等人已对非哈密顿图的极值问题进行了经典刻画。本文旨在将哈密顿性的极值结果推广到更一般的不相交路径覆盖性质，填补该领域在团数和谱半径条件下的空白。
AI.method: 主要运用了极值图论中的团计数方法和谱图论中的$\alpha$-谱半径分析，结合结构分析构造极图。
AI.result: 设$G$为$n$阶$k$-连通图，最小度$\delta(G)\ge k$。本文给出了$G$具有一对一、一对多和多对多$t$-不相交路径覆盖时，关于$s$-团数$N(G, K_s)$和$\alpha$-谱半径$\lambda_\alpha(G)$的充分条件，并刻画了达到这些界的极图。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将哈密顿性的经典极值定理推广到了更一般的不相交路径覆盖情形，为图论中路径覆盖问题的极值研究提供了新的视角和方法。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确提及开放问题，但自然延伸包括：考虑其他图参数（如度序列、连通度）下的类似极值问题，或将结果推广到有向图或超图的不相交路径覆盖。

title: DP vertex-arboricity of sparse graphs
summary: The vertex arboricity $\mathrm{va}(G)$ of a multigraph $G$ is the minimum number $k$ for which $V(G)$ can be partitioned into $k$ subsets, each of which induces an acyclic subgraph of $G$. By definition, if $\mathrm{va}(G)= k$, then the chromatic number, $χ(G)$, satisfies $k\leq χ(G)\leq 2k$. Fundamental results by Borodin from 1976 and Bollobás and Manvel from 1979 imply an analog of Gallai's lower bound on the number of edges in a $(2k-1)$-critical graph. We consider a slight generalization of vertex arboricity in the setting of DP-coloring. Using this framework, we derive lower bounds on the number of edges in graphs critical for vertex arboricity and for list arboricity that are better than Gallai's bound, along with similar bounds in our DP-setting.

title: Sandpile groups of random bipartite graphs and families of distributions with the same moments
summary: Recently, there has been significant interest in applying the method of moments developed by Wood and others to study distributions of finite abelian groups that arise in number theory and combinatorics. When the moments do not grow too fast, they determine a unique distribution. We construct large families of distributions that have the same moments. These families include several distributions that arise naturally in the study of sandpile groups of families of random graphs. Wood determined the distribution of Sylow $p$-subgroups of sandpile groups of Erdős--Rényi random graphs. This was extended by Mészáros to sandpile groups of random $d$-regular graphs, who observed an interesting special case when $d$ is even and $p = 2$. We study Sylow $p$-subgroups of sandpile groups of random bipartite graphs and similarly find a special case for $p =2$. Although this distribution differs from that of Mészáros, we show that they have the same moments and fit into our broader construction. To compute the moments of the distributions we study, we apply combinatorial tools from the theory of Hall--Littlewood functions.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了具有相同矩的分布族，包含随机二部图沙堆群的Sylow $p$-子群分布，并发现$p=2$时的特殊情形与随机$d$-正则图情形有相同矩。
AI.motivation: Wood等人发展的矩方法用于研究数论和组合中有限阿贝尔群的分布，但矩增长过快时分布不唯一。本文旨在构造具有相同矩的大族分布，填补了矩方法中唯一性条件的空白，并与随机图沙堆群的具体分布相关联。
AI.method: 利用Hall-Littlewood函数的组合工具计算矩，结合矩方法构造分布族。
AI.result: 构造了具有相同矩的分布族，包含随机二部图$G(n,n,p)$的沙堆群Sylow $p$-子群分布，特别地，当$p=2$时该分布与Mészáros得到的随机$d$-正则图（$d$为偶数）的分布不同但具有相同矩。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了不同随机图模型（二部图与正则图）的沙堆群分布可能共享相同矩，表明矩方法在区分分布时的局限性，并展示了Hall-Littlewood函数在计算矩中的有效性。
AI.future_work: 可进一步探索其他随机图模型（如随机有向图）的沙堆群分布是否也属于该构造，或研究这些分布族的其他统计性质（如熵、大偏差）。

title: Two-block cycles and chromatic number of Hamiltonian digraphs
summary: Let $k$ and $\ell$ be positive integers. The family $C(k,\ell)$ consists of all digraphs obtained from two internally vertex-disjoint directed paths of lengths at least $k$ and $\ell$, respectively, and identifying their initial vertices and their terminal vertices. Addario-Berry, Havet and Thomassé (JCT-B, 2007) asked whether, for any positive integers $k$ and $\ell$ with $k+\ell \ge 4$, the chromatic number $χ(D)$ is at most $k+\ell-1$ for every $C(k,\ell)$-free strongly connected digraph $D$. Let $D$ be a $C(k,\ell)$-free Hamiltonian digraph. Kim, Kim, Ma and Park (JGT, 2018) showed that $χ(D) \le k+\ell$ and the bound is attained when $k+\ell=5$. In this paper, we prove that $χ(D) \le k+\ell-1$ for $k+\ell\ge 6$ and this bound is best possible for all $k+\ell\geq 6$, which resolves the problem posed by Addario-Berry, Havet and Thomassé for Hamiltonian digraphs.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了对于不含 $C(k,\ell)$ 的哈密顿有向图 $D$，其色数 $\chi(D) \le k+\ell-1$（$k+\ell \ge 6$），且该界是紧的，从而解决了 Addario-Berry、Havet 和 Thomassé 关于哈密顿有向图的猜想。
AI.motivation: Addario-Berry、Havet 和 Thomassé 在 2007 年提出猜想：对于不含 $C(k,\ell)$ 的强连通有向图 $D$，色数 $\chi(D) \le k+\ell-1$。该问题与有向图的色数上界和禁止子结构相关，是图论中经典问题。Kim 等人（2018）证明了哈密顿情形下 $\chi(D) \le k+\ell$，但未达到猜想界。本文旨在填补这一空白，证明哈密顿情形下界可改进至 $k+\ell-1$。
AI.method: 本文采用构造性方法和极值图论技术，通过分析哈密顿有向图中 $C(k,\ell)$ 的结构性质，利用反证法构造染色或导出矛盾。具体地，通过哈密顿圈和路径分解，结合色数下界与结构约束，得到紧的上界。
AI.result: 主要定理：设 $D$ 是 $C(k,\ell)$-free 哈密顿有向图，$k+\ell \ge 6$，则 $\chi(D) \le k+\ell-1$，且该界是紧的，即存在 $C(k,\ell)$-free 哈密顿有向图达到该色数。
AI.conclusion: 该结果完全解决了哈密顿有向图情形下 Addario-Berry、Havet 和 Thomassé 的猜想，表明色数上界与 $k+\ell$ 线性相关，且哈密顿性足以将界降低 1。这为一般强连通有向图的情形提供了重要参考。
AI.future_work: 论文未提及具体开放问题。自然延伸是考虑一般强连通有向图（非哈密顿）是否也满足 $\chi(D) \le k+\ell-1$，或寻找反例。此外，可研究其他禁止子结构（如 $C(k,\ell)$ 的变体）对色数的影响。

title: Gilbreath's conjecture: a Cramér random model and a deterministic analysis
summary: Gilbreath's conjecture asserts that if one starts with the sequence of primes and takes successive absolute differences to create a triangular array, then the left diagonal of this array consists entirely of ones after the first row. In this paper, we show that the analogue of this conjecture for a Cramér random model holds, in which the (normalized) prime gaps are replaced by independent random variables with geometric distributions of logarithmic size. We also give some preliminary analysis of the associated continuous probabilistic model for this problem, as well as a deterministic "inverse theorem" that isolates the specific obstructions to Gilbreath's conjecture (assuming a Cramér type bound on prime gaps), namely long blocks of zeroes, or very long shallow $\{0,d\}$-valued blocks for some $d \geq 2$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明Gilbreath猜想在Cramér随机模型下成立，并给出确定性逆定理刻画其障碍。
AI.motivation: Gilbreath猜想是数论中一个长期未解决的开放问题，涉及素数序列的绝对差阵列。该猜想与素数分布的结构有关，但缺乏严格证明。本文通过随机模型和确定性分析，为理解该猜想提供了新视角。
AI.method: 使用Cramér随机模型（将素数间隙替换为独立同分布几何随机变量），结合概率方法；同时引入连续概率模型和确定性逆定理分析，利用长零块或浅{0,d}值块刻画障碍。
AI.result: 1. 在Cramér随机模型中，Gilbreath猜想以概率1成立。2. 给出确定性逆定理：若素数间隙满足Cramér型界，则猜想失败仅当存在长零块或非常长的浅{0,d}值块（d≥2）。
AI.conclusion: 该结果支持Gilbreath猜想在随机意义下的合理性，并将原猜想归约为对素数间隙中特定模式（长零块或浅块）的排除，为最终证明提供了方向。
AI.future_work: 进一步研究连续概率模型的精确性质，以及如何利用素数分布的最新进展（如Maynard的间隙结果）来排除逆定理中的障碍块，从而推进原猜想的证明。
